## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 161 captures during May 2020. The activity was carried out through the clinic’s scheduled photographic sessions. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issues were recorded in the information provided. The level of activity represents the total number of captures completed at the site during the month.

## Image quality

Image quality remained suitable for grading in most cases. There were 5 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 3.1 per cent. These images could not be used for a reliable grading outcome. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention to any recurring factors that may affect image assessability during future sessions.

## Grading

Grading identified 28 referable results from the completed captures. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 days. This provides the reported measure of the time taken for images to proceed through grading during May 2020. The site should continue to review grading turnaround and image quality as part of its routine operational monitoring.
